# Track My Train — llms.txt
# https://trackmytrain.pk

## About
Track My Train (trackmytrain.pk) is Pakistan's most advanced independent live train tracking platform. It provides real-time GPS positions, delay analytics, speed data, and accurate ETAs for 164+ Pakistan Railways trains across 342+ stations. The platform is 100% free, requires no signup, and works on any browser.

## Key Facts
- Coverage: 164+ passenger trains, 342+ stations, all 4 provinces of Pakistan
- Update frequency: GPS positions refresh every 5 seconds
- Cost: Completely free, no account required
- Technology: GPS telemetry ingestion, geospatial snap-to-rail algorithms, real-time delay computation
- Independence: NOT affiliated with Pakistan Railways or any government entity
- Language: English only
- Founded: 2024

## Features
- Live Train Tracker: Real-time GPS positions for all active trains
- Journey Planner: Find direct trains between any two stations
- Find My Train (GPS): Auto-detect which train you're riding using phone GPS
- Check Delays: Real-time delay status for every running train
- Train Schedule: Complete 2026 timetables with running days
- Ticket Pricing: Updated fares for all classes (Economy, AC Standard, AC Business, Sleeper)
- Station Directory: 342+ stations with facilities, platforms, and connecting trains
- Route Maps: All major railway corridors with distance and duration data
- Green Line Express: Dedicated page for Pakistan's premium train service
- Blog & Travel Guides: Original editorial content about Pakistan railway travel

## Popular Routes
- Karachi to Lahore (Green Line Express, Tezgam, Karakoram Express)
- Lahore to Islamabad/Rawalpindi (multiple daily services)
- Karachi to Peshawar (Khyber Mail — longest route, 1,680 km)
- Quetta to Peshawar (Jaffar Express — scenic Bolan Pass route)

## Top Trains
1. Green Line Express (101UP/102DN) — Fastest: Islamabad–Karachi, 18 hours
2. Tezgam Express (7UP/8DN) — Most iconic: Karachi–Rawalpindi, 22 hours
3. Karakoram Express (11UP/12DN) — Most popular: Karachi–Lahore, 22 hours
4. Khyber Mail (1UP/2DN) — Longest: Karachi–Peshawar, 30 hours
5. Business Express (5UP/6DN) — Business class: Karachi–Lahore, 20 hours
